title: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 2

entities.name: Dawn
entities.description: A young survivor and inventor of traps who escaped the carnival's fall and now builds weapons in the attic encampment.

entities.name: City
entities.description: Dawn's former friend and forager, now an acolyte of the Devouring Father who spared her and invites her to the Valley of Serenity.

entities.name: Rill
entities.description: A friend of Dawn from the carnival, believed dead or transformed.

entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: The being City serves and credits with sparing Dawn's life.

entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: The House-world that has suddenly turned hostile and attacks every settlement.

entities.name: The Attic Encampment
entities.description: A settlement in the attic that sheltered Dawn and is wiped out in an attack.

entities.name: The Valley of Serenity
entities.description: The place where City invites Dawn to join his group for the Devouring Father's peace.

entities.name: The Mutemoors
entities.description: A region of echoes Dawn passes through.

entities.name: The Floodpits
entities.description: A dripping cool region where Dawn hopes to find the Benefactors.

entities.name: Benefactors
entities.description: Survivors in patched clothes hiding in a theater who fight the House and welcome Dawn.

entities.name: Razorkin
entities.description: Monsters that strip skins from the slain in the attic.

entities.name: Wickerfolk
entities.description: Monsters that entwine victims and may trap them in woven skins.

entities.name: Cellarspawn
entities.description: Monsters that rip victims apart and can come from the walls.

entities.name: Glitch ghosts
entities.description: Shuddering color-void spirits that emerge from shards of glass.

events.summary: In a nightmare memory, Dawn flees the burning carnival as survivors die behind her.
events.quote: Dawn ran, and the carnival that was the only home she had ever known burned behind her

events.summary: In the dream, City looms from the woods, saying the Devouring Father is still hungry.
events.quote: The Devouring Father is still hungry

events.summary: Dawn wakes screaming in the attic encampment, annoying the guards.
events.quote: Dawn woke up screaming, kicking off the thin blanket

events.summary: Dawn recalls how she found an unguarded tunnel to the attic and warned its leads before monsters attacked the carnival's doors.
events.quote: Finding an unguarded tunnel to the attic encampment had been sheer luck

events.summary: Survivors her age treat Dawn with suspicion because her escape was convenient.
events.quote: most of the survivors her own age treated her with suspicion

events.summary: The House has turned hostile, attacking or erasing every settlement in recent weeks.
events.quote: Every settlement and gathering place they still had contact with had been attacked in the last weeks

events.summary: Dawn builds a shock box from a kitchen device and a battery in her workshop.
events.quote: Prying the bottom off her metal rectangle, which she was already beginning to think of as a shock box

events.summary: Dawn activates her shock wand and thinks of Rill, who she fears is dead or transformed.
events.quote: Rill was never going to see.

events.summary: A bang and total silence tell Dawn that the attic's occupants have been killed.
events.quote: There was a certain quality to the absolute silence that descended on a room whose occupants had been killed.

events.summary: City, outside the door, tells Dawn he asked the Devouring Father to spare her and invites her to the Valley of Serenity.
events.quote: I asked him for your life, and he granted it to me

events.summary: Dawn emerges to find few bodies, with skins taken by razorkin, and takes a machete.
Dawn travels through the Mutemoors toward the Floodpits to seek the Benefactors.
events.quote: She had heard rumors the Benefactors would be found there.

events.summary: A glitch ghost reaches for Dawn from a shard of glass; her shock wand shatters it as the battery dies.
events.quote: She aimed her shock wand at it and pressed the button that should increase the voltage

events.summary: The ghost shatters just as the wand's battery expires, leaving Dawn defenseless.
events.quote: the ghost shattering into a million specks of light even as the battery crackled and expired

events.summary: Survivors pull Dawn into a disused theater and welcome her to the Benefactors.
events.quote: We heard you'd been looking for us.

events.summary: The Benefactors take her wand to install fresh batteries and Dawn feels safe, though City's words echo.

relations.note: Calls himself the Devouring Father's most beloved new acolyte.
relations.quote: our Devouring Father doing a glorious favor for his most beloved new acolyte

relations.note: Once beloved friend who spares her and invites her to join him.
Dawn's friend, whom she imagines being impressed by the shocker.
relations.quote: thinking about how impressed Rill would be
